issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI: testRefusedCancelRowsUseLabelKeysAndKeepTheReasonVisible expects '1 link' after leaving one-off on
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-dw.3 note #2 (epic bob-cli-dw, phase mac-unconfigured-theme-ci); confirmed by the bob-cli-dw land agent.

bob-mac-capture master c8c4366 ("feat(mac-capture): show refused relation cancel reasons", plan 202610/relation_card_refused_cancel_rows.md, a tale now marked done) fails macOS 26 SwiftPM run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40750655496 (job 123036129488). Of 3267 tests, exactly one fails:

CaptureRelationPanelTests.swift:1566: testRefusedCancelRowsUseLabelKeysAndKeepTheReasonVisible: XCTAssertEqual failed: ("Optional("one-off · 1 link")") is not equal to ("Optional("1 link")")

With master red again, Bundle, launch smoke, and install are skipped, so master loses the green macOS signal that bob-cli-dr recovered at 2c3407d (run 40746228778, 3265 tests, 0 failures).

Root cause: earlier in the same test, `model.relationLabelPrompt?.oneOff = true` is set to check the refused footer, and it is never reset. `CapturePanelModel.relationLabelPromptBadgeText` (Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelModel.swift ~7494) prefixes `one-off · ` whenever `prompt.oneOff` is set. The badge for the later "duplicate of" selection is therefore correct for the model, and the test expectation is wrong. The one-off prefix comes from the bob-cli-bj relation-card work (556bb67), which predates c8c4366.

Fix: reset `oneOff` before the final selection, or assert `one-off · 1 link`, whichever matches the intended one-off persistence in docs/relationship-pickers.md. Do not change one-off badge semantics just to make this pass. Verify on the macOS CI path (master push run green, with Bundle/launch/install executing). A local Linux run is not a substitute.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the test sets relationLabelPrompt.oneOff = true and never resets it, so the badge model always prefixes 'one-off · '; it is the only failure of 3267 in run 40750655496.

issue.creation_reason: The refused-cancel rows tale (c8c4366) put bob-mac-capture master macOS CI back to red with one wrong test expectation, skipping Bundle, launch, and install again right after bob-cli-dr restored the green signal.

payload.description: dr restored the green macOS master signal at 2c3407d; c8c4366's test regression broke it again
bj's relation-card one-off badge prefix (556bb67) is the behavior the failing test does not account for
Confirm links and status after creating it

evidence.note: Independent reproduction from the bob-cli-du land agent: bob-mac-capture master 072055d (bob-cli-du.8 mac-complete-cue) macOS CI run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40796512711 fails only CaptureRelationPanelTests.swift:1567 testRefusedCancelRowsUseLabelKeysAndKeepTheReasonVisible ('one-off · 1 link' vs '1 link'); intervening 5726b4f run 40793961410 fails identically at :1566. Build passes; Bundle/launch smoke/install are skipped, so the complete-label Mac work (CaptureRelationCompleteTests) also lacks a green macOS signal until this lands. Not caused by bob-cli-du.
